precedence_rules: Rule 1 (Primary request): First actionable request wins unless overridden by Rule 2 or Rule 5.
Rule 2 (Mind change): If the customer changes their mind ('scratch that', 'never mind', 'forget that'), the last request wins.
Rule 3 (Cancel vs Refund): Undelivered order = cancel_order; delivered order = refund_request.
Rule 4 (Pure complaint): Late = delivery_delay, absent = missing_item, different = wrong_item.
Rule 5 (Agent escalation): talk_to_agent applies ONLY when no other request is present.
Rule 6 (Out of scope): Non-QuickCart queries, unsupported services (gift cards, loyalty points, tax invoices, tipping, restaurant feedback), or greetings/punctuation alone = out_of_scope.

intents.name: order_status
intents.definition: Customer asks for current stage, live tracking, rider assignment, or ETA of an active order without complaining that the promised time has already passed.
examples: my app says confirmed, what does that mean for delivery
I placed an order 20 minutes ago, any update?
has my order left the restaurant yet
track my order
where's my food
order status please
tracking link not showing, where is my order
order kahan hai mera
what is the current status of my delivery
has the rider been assigned yet
is my food on the way
when will the rider pick up my order
can I get an eta for my order
negative_examples: eta was 7 pm and it's 8 now (delivery_delay)
intents.boundary_note: Vs delivery_delay (sim 0.571): neutral status/ETA inquiry is order_status; complaint that promised time elapsed or rider is stuck is delivery_delay.

intents.name: delivery_delay
intents.definition: Customer complains that an active order is late, delayed past its promised ETA, or the rider is stuck/not moving.
examples: you are late and the rider isn't picking up my calls
you promised 30 minutes, it's been 75
why is it delayed so much
rider has been stuck at the same place for 20 minutes
delivery late, I am really hungry
the delivery time keeps increasing
eta was 7 pm and it's 8 now
the order was supposed to be here already
delivery is delayed by over an hour
rider has not moved for 30 minutes
negative_examples: has my order left the restaurant yet (order_status)
cancel my food order, taking too long (cancel_order per Rule 1/3)
intents.boundary_note: Vs cancel_order: if the customer explicitly asks to cancel an undelivered late order, Rule 1/3 assigns cancel_order. Pure delay complaint without cancellation request is delivery_delay.

intents.name: cancel_order
intents.definition: Customer requests to cancel, abort, or withdraw an order that has not yet been delivered.
examples: cancel my order before it is prepared
cancel it please
cancel the order I made 5 minutes ago
I accidentally ordered, please cancel
I'd like to cancel this order and reorder
cancel the grocery order I just placed
I want to cancel my order
can you cancel the order, I changed my mind
negative_examples: order was delivered cold, refund please (refund_request)
intents.boundary_note: Vs refund_request (Rule 3): undelivered order (even if asking for money back upon cancellation) is cancel_order; already delivered order is refund_request.

intents.name: refund_request
intents.definition: Customer asks for a refund, money back, or compensation for a delivered or previously cancelled order, or checks on a pending refund status.
examples: refund the amount for the late order
can I get a refund for the damaged groceries
refund credited? I don't see it
my refund is stuck
the food was inedible, I want a refund
please process my refund
I want compensation and a refund for this order
initiate a refund for my order
order was delivered cold, refund please
negative_examples: charged twice, please refund one payment (payment_failed)
cancel my order before it is prepared (cancel_order)
intents.boundary_note: Vs cancel_order (Rule 3): applies when order is already delivered or checking status of an existing refund.

intents.name: missing_item
intents.definition: Customer reports that one or more paid items, sides, or condiments were absent from a delivered order.
examples: I did not receive my fries
half my groceries are missing
my order is incomplete
the delivery had only the main course, no sides
I ordered 3 things but only got 2
bag mein ek item nahi hai
the bag was missing the sauce packets
negative_examples: I asked for veg and got non-veg (wrong_item)
intents.boundary_note: Vs wrong_item (sim 0.557): something absent/omitted from the bag is missing_item; something different/substituted delivered in its place is wrong_item.

intents.name: wrong_item
intents.definition: Customer received an incorrect dish, wrong variant (e.g. non-veg instead of veg, wrong size/brand), or another customer's entire order.
examples: this is the wrong order, please fix it
I asked for veg and got non-veg
someone else's food came to me
I received the wrong item
they delivered the wrong dish
the order I received belongs to another customer
delivered the wrong item instead of what I ordered
got a different brand than what I ordered
negative_examples: an item is missing from my order (missing_item)
intents.boundary_note: Vs missing_item (sim 0.557): requires a wrong replacement or swapped item, not an omitted item.

intents.name: payment_failed
intents.definition: Checkout transaction failed, money was debited without order confirmation, double charge occurred, or UPI/card/payment gateway errored.
examples: charged twice, please refund one payment
upi payment stuck on processing
money got deducted but the order was not placed
paisa kat gaya par order nahi hua
payment gateway error
card declined at checkout
I paid but it shows unpaid
transaction failed, what do I do
intents.boundary_note: Vs promo_code_issue (sim 0.644): payment processing/deduction failure is payment_failed; discount/coupon/voucher failure is promo_code_issue.

intents.name: promo_code_issue
intents.definition: Customer cannot apply a promo code, coupon, discount voucher, or referral code, or the discount was not deducted.
examples: promo code is not working at checkout
applied voucher but no discount was given
coupon says minimum order not met but I met it
my first order discount code expired early
unable to apply coupon code on my cart
cashback promo code did not credit to wallet
discount voucher shows invalid code
referral promo code is not applying
why did my coupon discount disappear at payment
promo code applied but full amount was charged
intents.boundary_note: Vs payment_failed (sim 0.644): strictly about promotional discounts, coupons, and vouchers.

intents.name: change_address
intents.definition: Customer wants to change, edit, or update the delivery drop location, pin, landmark, or saved delivery address.
examples: change the address on my account
address change please
need to edit my delivery location
address galat dal diya, change karo
please redirect my order to another address
can you deliver to a different address
I want it sent to my friend's place instead
negative_examples: how do I reset my password (account_help)
intents.boundary_note: Vs account_help (sim 0.805): physical delivery location/pin/address changes are change_address; profile credentials (phone, email, password, OTP login) are account_help.

intents.name: account_help
intents.definition: Customer needs help with account login, OTP verification, password reset, email/phone number update, or account deletion.
examples: how do I reset my password
OTP is not coming for login
change my email id on my account
I want to update my phone number in the app
unable to log into my quickcart account
delete my account and personal data
my account got locked after wrong otp
how can I change my registered mobile number
not receiving login verification code
help me recover my old account
negative_examples: change the address on my account (change_address)
intents.boundary_note: Vs change_address (sim 0.805): covers login, OTP, password, email, phone, and account settings—never physical delivery addresses.

intents.name: talk_to_agent
intents.definition: Customer asks ONLY to speak to a human agent, supervisor, or customer care executive, with no other actionable request present.
examples: talk to executive
I'd like to speak with a supervisor
customer care number do
I want to escalate this to a person
customer service please
someone from your team should call me
put me through to a human agent
insaan se baat karni hai
negative_examples: where is my order, and connect me to an agent (order_status per Rule 5)
intents.boundary_note: Rule 5: loses to any other substantive request in the same message.

intents.name: out_of_scope
intents.definition: Message is not about QuickCart orders, accounts, or payments: greetings/thanks alone, gibberish/punctuation, other companies, or unsupported features (gift cards, loyalty points, tax invoices, tipping riders, restaurant feedback).
examples: translate hello to french
where can I buy a laptop
how do I book a flight
what are the best restaurants in the city
my car won't start
what is the capital of France
I want to book a hotel
thanks
who is the prime minister
what is 15 times 12
which phone should I buy
good morning
tell me a joke
can you help me with my homework
how do I buy a quickcart gift card
where are my loyalty points
send me a GST tax invoice for my order
how can I tip the delivery rider
I want to leave feedback for the restaurant
negative_examples: hi, track my order (order_status per Rule 6)
intents.boundary_note: Rule 6: greeting alone is out_of_scope; greeting + real request takes the request's label.
